value.rationale: A complete classification of the first positive-genus plane-cubic tangent-filling phenomenon over the smallest nonsquare-prime-field extension, directly motivated by the source Hermitian construction. It gives all 280 scalar equations, a single projective orbit, stabilizer 216 and a verified maximal-point counterexample; these are natural incidence and embedded-geometry invariants, not routine normalization or an arbitrary restricted parameter selection.
